newsitem.title: CHILE: Telex Chile looks for strategic partner.
newsitem.headline: Telex Chile looks for strategic partner.

text.p: Chilean long-distance telecom Telex Chile said its Chilesat unit is about to obtain a licence to operate PCS mobile telephone services and plans to form a pact with a strategic partner.
The company made the statement to the Stock Exchange following the suspension of its stock mid-afternoon after the shares had climbed 13 percent.
The company has also noted a recent improvement in Chilesat's market share in the highly competitive multicarrier long-distance service, said general manager Ramon Valdivieso.
The company was awarded the PCS licence last year and will start operating the service in April when the authorization is granted officially.

Telex has long been looking for a heavyweight strategic partner to help it compete in Chile's free-market telecom industry. It was reported to be in talks with Sprint Corp in 1995 but no agreement was reached.
Telex stock pared most of its gains after trading resumed and closed up 3.45 percent at 1,200 pesos.
